These are parallel concepts, not a numeric comparison. Exactly two Chinese text lines, large and perfect: 跑步30分钟才燃脂？ ; 没有！脂肪从起步就参与. No other text, captions, labels, microtype, numbers or English anywhere. No people.

NO line graph, NO axes, NO curves, NO percentages, NO stacked bars, NO overlapping shapes suggesting relative supply proportions.
